    )

        x=span_right, y=deck_cy,
        width=0.5, height=deck_h,
        angle=0, density=density,
    )

        x=12.0, y=deck_cy,
        width=2.0, height=deck_h,
        angle=0, density=density,
    )
    strut_xs = [6.0, 7.0, 8.0, 9.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0]
    strut_bodies = []

            x=sx, y=strut_cy,
            width=strut_w, height=strut_h,
            angle=0, density=strut_density,
        )

    sandbox.add_joint(deck_left, strut_center, (sx_center, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_right, strut_center, (sx_center, deck_cy), type="pivot")
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, deck_left, (7.0, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_left, deck_right, (10.0, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_right, right_span, (13.0, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, strut_bodies[0][1], (span_left, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    sandbox.add_joint(right_span, strut_bodies[-1][1], (span_right, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    return deck_left

    deck_cy = 2.0
    deck_h = 0.2
    deck_density = 0.3  # Increased for stiffness
    strut_w = 0.18
    strut_density = 0.3
    strut_h = deck_cy - ground_top
    strut_cy = ground_top + strut_h / 2

    # Add left and right span beams to ensure the required span
    left_span = sandbox.add_beam(x=6.0, y=deck_cy, width=0.5, height=deck_h, density=deck_density)
    right_span = sandbox.add_beam(x=14.0, y=deck_cy, width=0.5, height=deck_h, density=deck_density)

    # Add intermediate deck beams with 1.5m width
    deck_positions = [7.5, 9.0, 10.5, 12.0, 13.5]
    deck_beams = []
    for x in deck_positions:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=x, y=deck_cy, width=1.5, height=deck_h, density=deck_density)
        deck_beams.append(beam)

    # Add struts at 1.5m intervals from x=6.0 to x=14.0
    strut_positions = [6.0, 7.5, 9.0, 10.5, 12.0, 13.5, 14.0]
    struts = []
    for sx in strut_positions:
        s = sandbox.add_beam(x=sx, y=strut_cy, width=strut_w, height=strut_h, density=strut_density)
        struts.append(s)
        sandbox.add_joint(s, None, (sx, ground_top), type='rigid')

    # Connect deck beams to struts with pivot joints
    for i, deck_beam in enumerate(deck_beams):
        left_sx = strut_positions[i]
        right_sx = strut_positions[i + 1]
        sandbox.add_joint(deck_beam, struts[i], (left_sx, deck_cy), type='pivot')
        sandbox.add_joint(deck_beam, struts[i + 1], (right_sx, deck_cy), type='pivot')

    # Connect left_span to first deck beam
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, struts[0], (6.0, deck_cy), type='pivot')
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, deck_beams[0], (6.25, deck_cy), type='pivot')

    # Connect right_span to last deck beam
    sandbox.add_joint(right_span, struts[-1], (14.0, deck_cy), type='pivot')
    sandbox.add_joint(right_span, deck_beams[-1], (13.75, deck_cy), type='pivot')

    # Add diagonal bracing to form truss-like structure
    for i, deck_beam in enumerate(deck_beams):
        left_sx = strut_positions[i]
        right_sx = strut_positions[i + 1]
        mid_x = (left_sx + right_sx) / 2
        # Left diagonal brace
        left_diag = sandbox.add_beam(x=left_sx, y=deck_cy, width=1.0, height=0.1, density=deck_density)
        sandbox.add_joint(left_diag, struts[i], (left_sx, strut_cy), type='rigid')
        sandbox.add_joint(left_diag, deck_beam, (left_sx, deck_cy), type='rigid')
        # Right diagonal brace
        right_diag = sandbox.add_beam(x=right_sx, y=deck_cy, width=1.0, height=0.1, density=deck_density)
        sandbox.add_joint(right_diag, struts[i + 1], (right_sx, strut_cy), type='rigid')
        sandbox.add_joint(right_diag, deck_beam, (right_sx, deck_cy), type='rigid')

    return left_span

def build_agent(sandbox):
    ground_top = sandbox.get_ground_y_top()
    deck_y = 2.0
    deck_h = 0.2
    deck_density = 0.3
    strut_w = 0.2
    strut_h = deck_y - ground_top
    strut_density = 0.3

    # Left and right span beams
    left_span = sandbox.add_beam(x=6.0, y=deck_y, width=0.5, height=deck_h, density=deck_density)
    right_span = sandbox.add_beam(x=14.0, y=deck_y, width=0.5, height=deck_h, density=deck_density)

    # Intermediate deck beams at 1.0m intervals from x=7.0 to x=13.0
    deck_positions = [7.0, 8.0, 9.0, 10.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0]
    deck_beams = [left_span]  # Include left span
    for x in deck_positions:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=x, y=deck_y, width=1.0, height=deck_h, density=deck_density)
        deck_beams.append(beam)
    deck_beams.append(right_span)  # Include right span

    # Struts at 1.0m intervals from x=6.0 to x=14.0
    strut_positions = list(range(6, 15))  # [6, 7, ..., 14]
    struts = []
    for sx in strut_positions:
        s = sandbox.add_beam(x=sx, y=ground_top + strut_h / 2, width=strut_w, height=strut_h, density=strut_density)
        struts.append(s)
        # Connect strut to ground with pivot
        sandbox.add_joint(s, None, (sx, ground_top), type='pivot')

    # Connect deck beams to adjacent struts with pivot joints
    for i, deck_beam in enumerate(deck_beams):
        left_sx = strut_positions[i]
        right_sx = strut_positions[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(strut_positions) else strut_positions[-1]
        # Connect to left strut
        sandbox.add_joint(deck_beam, struts[i], (left_sx, deck_y), type='pivot')
        # Connect to right strut
        if i + 1 < len(struts):
            sandbox.add_joint(deck_beam, struts[i + 1], (right_sx, deck_y), type='pivot')

    # Add diagonal bracing between deck and struts to form truss
    for i in range(len(deck_beams) - 1):
        deck_beam = deck_beams[i]
        next_deck = deck_beams[i + 1]
        left_strut = struts[i]
        right_strut = struts[i + 1]

        # Left diagonal brace
        left_diag = sandbox.add_beam(x=left_strut.position[0], y=deck_y, width=1.0, height=0.1, density=deck_density)
        sandbox.add_joint(left_diag, left_strut, (left_strut.position[0], ground_top + strut_h / 2), type='pivot')
        sandbox.add_joint(left_diag, deck_beam, (deck_beam.position[0], deck_y), type='pivot')

        # Right diagonal brace
        right_diag = sandbox.add_beam(x=right_strut.position[0], y=deck_y, width=1.0, height=0.1, density=deck_density)
        sandbox.add_joint(right_diag, right_strut, (right_strut.position[0], ground_top + strut_h / 2), type='pivot')
        sandbox.add_joint(right_diag, next_deck, (next_deck.position[0], deck_y), type='pivot')

    return left_span
